answers.a: Student Assistant at Institute of Data Science Foundations, Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH), Hamburg, Germany (Feb — Jul 2025). Measured how often simulated and measured beam-quality values agreed, then investigated the 21 high-error cases and found most of them clustered on a single measurement date — pointing to experiment-specific or data-quality issues rather than the simulation itself.
answers.label: Student Assistant — TUHH

answers.a: At TUHH: 189 measurements compared against 189 simulations; 88.9% of cases met the defined error threshold; 86% of the 21 high-error cases traced to the same measurement date.
